parsing.description: Changing untrusted container/schema/value decoding or parsing budgets.

mcp.description: Changing MCP instructions, tool discovery or built-in workflow guidance.

gcs.description: Changing the gs:// snapshot handoff, its download cache or refresh.

performance.description: Measuring load time and memory, reading the perf baseline, changing cache or decode cost.

fig-format.description: Changing decoding, instance expansion, emitted REST fields or variables.

bundle.description: Changing the bundle zip, manifest, context.md, batch bundles, font inventory or verify.

render.description: Changing SVG or raster rendering: text and glyphs, image fills, effects, export areas, image adjustments.

preview.description: Changing the local viewer, offline HTML, handoff or screenshot comparison.

pi.description: Changing the Pi extension, reviewed component mappings or its npm packaging.

accuracy.description: Measuring output against Figma's own exports, running compare, finding test files, the CI regression corpus.

release.description: Packaging, GitHub releases, Homebrew, npm, install scripts and figlens update.

review.description: Deliver features/optimizations across CLI, MCP, Pi, OpenCode and OMP; review changes, follow up on PR reviews and CI, and open issues.

direction.description: Deciding what to build next, or revisiting a past decision.

ai-context.description: Maintain the doc router: add, move or split topics and pages, and fix check failures.

integrations.description: Changing OpenCode V2/OMP entries, shared host packaging, permissions, ownership or installed-adapter acceptance.

search.description: Changing search indexing, normalization, ranking, cursors, coverage or its budgets.

unrouted.wiki/prototype.md: Field reference linked from fig-format.md, states.md and preview.md; read when changing prototype projection, provenance or unknown markers.
unrouted.wiki/states.md: Field reference linked from fig-format.md and wiki/README.md; read when changing related-variant inventory or its limits.
unrouted.wiki/semantics.md: Field reference linked from fig-format.md and README.md; read when changing partial semantics or provenance.
unrouted.wiki/history/pi-workflow.md: Historical milestone indexed in wiki/README.md; read only when explicitly revisiting this implementation.
